title: CDK: infrastructure in a real language, and what it generates

videos.script: A template is a list. Twenty buckets are twenty entries, and a rule for all of them is written twenty times. {{list}} The Cloud Development Kit writes the list from a program. A loop makes the buckets. A function holds the rule. The result is still a CloudFormation template. {{program}} That is the useful part, and the risk. One line in your code can become a whole policy in the template, and a reviewer reading the code does not see it. {{expand}} This lesson writes the shop's base stack as a program, and reads what it generates, line by line. {{read}} Then it sends the template to moto, and finds three resources missing, with the stack reported complete. {{missing}} And it writes tests that read the template itself. So a decision someone undoes by accident fails in the build, before anything exists. {{tests}} By the end, you know what a construct wrote for you, and you have a test that will say so when it stops. {{end}}
